calls.statement: SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS d, min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc) FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-30'

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, o.status, o.dispatch_ts_utc,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id=900 AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27')
SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS orders,
 sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines, sum(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badstatus,
 sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_code IS NULL OR channel_code<>'WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonWB
FROM w

calls.statement:
SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS after_sep, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(f.net_amount) nt
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT o.status, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_lines, sum(CASE WHEN o.line_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lc_mismatch
FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-11-05' GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period,
       ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) AS web_sales_gross_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
